steps.title: Pause. Gather. Reassess.
steps.body:
[fade]Take a moment before deciding.[/fade]
- [marker]Notice the **key evidence**.[/marker]
- [underline]Consider another explanation.[/underline]
- Keep ==uncertainty== in view.

steps.prompt: Which habit helps you reconsider an assumption?
steps.explanation: [fade]Make room for another possibility.[/fade] [marker]Review the evidence[/marker] and [underline]reassess your first impression[/underline].
